answer: Each new agent locks a bond of 500 tokens for three epochs before its votes count, and peers check that the bond came from a wallet with real past work. A farm of 1,000 fakes must lock 500,000 tokens and wait, which wipes out any reward it could steal. Splitting funds across many fresh wallets fails, since each wallet still needs its own work history. An honest agent, whether it maps a reef, tracks a falcon nest or sells yarrow seed, pays the bond once and gets it back in full after the wait.
